reply_text:
I answered Dana in her #north-team thread: the 2026 renewal at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 261 seats. Ilse Varga posted that figure in #north-team on Oct 14, and it's the most recent one in the channel.

The only other seat count there is 185, from Aug 2025. That's the old Amendment No. 1 figure (Dana first typed 180, then corrected it), not the 2026 renewal.

I haven't checked 261 against a signed renewal document. I suggested Dana confirm it with Ilse before treating it as final for the tracker.
